report.question: How do robust tangencies obstruct finite statistical descriptions, how do renormalizations implant arbitrary local models, and how does emergence distinguish complexity of orbit statistics from periodic-point growth or metric entropy? Which conclusions are residual, positive-measure, generic-family almost-every-parameter or every-parameter, and in which dimension, map class and regularity?
report.reading_scope: Complete official mathematical report sections 1.1-3.4, all numbered results/questions, footnotes and bibliography read, rather than abstract only; relevant official PDF text cross-checked. Figures were not visually inspected. Supplementary primary sources were read only in the explicitly listed scopes below. Original Newhouse, GST, Kaloshin, Berger-Biebler, SRB, KAM, Oseledets and Pesin proofs are external inputs, not claimed reconstructed.
report.coverage_status: 46 independent knowledge pages, one narrative outline and one reference. Wild hyperbolicity and finite-regularity parameter quantifiers, primitive renormalization and universality, entropy prerequisites, statistical emergence and analytic pseudo-rotation branches are covered with separate local hypotheses. Strong regularity and standard-map motivation are bounded narrative context, not new claimed theorems. No full research-theorem proof or whole-repository validation is claimed.

proof_scope.3101: Defines local versus global diffeomorphisms and joint finite/smooth family topology; gives a covering-map example separating local invertibility from global injectivity.
proof_scope.3102: Defines uniform hyperbolic splitting on a compact invariant set; no structural stability or stable-manifold theorem is folded into this definition.
proof_scope.3103: Defines saddle stable/unstable sets and quadratic homoclinic tangency; elementary normal separation calculation. Existence of leaves is delegated to 311A.
proof_scope.3104: Complete adapted-norm contraction proof, using Jordan decomposition and nilpotence; proves the entire basin is a nonempty open union of inverse images and computes periodic empirical averages.
proof_scope.3105: Defines robust tangency of varying leaves of a continued basic set. No claim that a fixed tangency point persists.
proof_scope.3106: Newhouse's sink-creation theorem is external; the countable open-dense intersection producing infinitely many sinks is proved.
proof_scope.3107: Complete construction of a residual null set by small open neighborhoods of rational points.
proof_scope.3108: Defines generic-family/almost-every-parameter quantifiers and distinguishes the stronger every-parameter conclusion and the zero-dimensional case.
proof_scope.3109: Cites finite-regularity all-parameter infinite-sink theorem with annulus local-diffeomorphism versus dimension-at-least-three diffeomorphism distinction. Parablender mechanism is explicitly an outline, not a full proof; C-infinity extension remains conjectural.
proof_scope.3110: Defines maximal oscillation; proves two distinct invariant cluster measures force failure of a continuous observable's time average. Quadratic/rational maximal-order existence theorems and quantitative lower bounds remain external.
proof_scope.3111: Complete proof that asymptotic stability is open, that a stable component consists of one asymptotic class, and that asymptotic orbits have identical empirical cluster sets by a Cesaro W1 bound.
proof_scope.3112: Cites degree-six real Henon wandering domains and Cr/analytic Newhouse-domain density. Positive-order and complex Fatou conclusions are external; no residual or full-measure upgrade.
proof_scope.3113: Defines corrected double-log pointwise and averaged local-order conventions; checks elementary mass examples. Helfter's pointwise comparison is external, and only its integration consequence is derived. No exchange of integral and limsup.
proof_scope.3114: Cites analytic pseudo-rotations of maximal averaged local order on annulus, sphere and disk, reusing 0P analytic/AbC foundations. Does not identify this with an ergodic construction or prove the analytic approximation theorem anew.
proof_scope.3115: Defines physical measure and states only the fixed-small-nonzero-b Henon-family consequence of the report's broader robustness theorem. Parameter exclusion and SRB/basin conclusions are external.
proof_scope.3119: Separates basic-set/local-maximality definitions from the cited hyperbolic continuation theorem; period preservation uses existing conjugacy theory.
proof_scope.310A: Defines the report's robust projection property of unstable leaves of a continued hyperbolic basic set. No unproved claim about full-dimensional interior of the set itself.
proof_scope.310B: Complete Taylor remainder, Leibniz and rescaled-cutoff estimate for a vanishing jet. Does not turn a finite differentiability estimate into a uniform analytic or C-infinity parameter construction.
proof_scope.310C: Explicit inverse, Jacobian determinant and area factor of generalized Henon maps; distinguishes b=0, b nonzero and b=1.
proof_scope.310D: Defines primitive renormalization, conformally symplectic charts and the disjoint N-level return tower.
proof_scope.310E: Complete proof that a q-periodic model orbit lifts to exact period Nq, using all tower levels, plus similarity of derivative return maps.
proof_scope.310F: Complete Baire argument extracting a common-period open subset from a periodic spot; analytic obstruction uses 311B.
proof_scope.310G: Cites multi-tangency polynomial Henon renormalization with independent unfolding, connected saddles, dissipative/symplectic distinction and finite-order error estimates. No full rescaling proof.
proof_scope.310H: Cites arbitrary periodic-point creation and proves the Baire conclusion. Counts hyperbolic fixed points of f^k, not necessarily points of exact period k.
proof_scope.310I: Cites the finite-r all-parameter arbitrary-growth result. Does not claim a common subsequence for all parameters or a C-infinity/analytic extension.
proof_scope.310J: Defines universality by density of primitive renormalizations, distinguishing orientation-preserving and symplectic model classes and approximation from equality.
proof_scope.310K: States the separate high-dimensional C1 and surface Cr universality theorems, with the higher-regularity high-dimensional branch left open.
proof_scope.310L: Cites the exact near-identity renormalization theorem for ball diffeomorphisms; the analogous exact symplectic statement remains a question.
proof_scope.310M: States precise simple elliptic spectrum, low-order nonresonance and invertible Birkhoff twist matrix from BT25b Definition 2.1. No proof of the normal form or KAM persistence.
proof_scope.310N: Defines localizable, openly localizable and generically localizable properties in the smooth symplectic setting.
proof_scope.310O: Cites BT25b Theorem E in the jointly C-infinity nondegenerate elliptic family space and proves only its countable-conjunction consequence.
proof_scope.310P: Deduces the all-parameter generic symplectic universality conclusion from the cited localizability proposition and Theorem E.
proof_scope.310Q: Cites Berger-Turaev positive-area-entropy perturbation near an elliptic point. Construction paragraph is a proof outline. Separates analytic/billiard/geodesic open problems.
proof_scope.310R: Complete telescoping proof that empirical-measure cluster points are invariant.
proof_scope.310S: Complete metric separation, Lipschitz approximation and finite-net proof that the dual W1 metric induces weak convergence on compact spaces.
proof_scope.310T: Deduces simultaneous convergence against all continuous functions from Birkhoff on a countable dense family and compactness; ergodic decomposition is a cited structural theorem.
proof_scope.310U: Defines statistical emergence and proves its conservative average-quantization formulation by dominated convergence; distinguishes positive order from merely superpolynomial growth.
proof_scope.310V: Complete finite-atomic quantization argument giving eventual exact emergence count; ergodic case gives one.
proof_scope.310W: Complete grid upper bound and arbitrary-center barycenter lower bound on the cube, proving polynomial emergence and zero order.
proof_scope.310X: Complete finite-space-net and mass-rounding upper bound proving emergence order at most manifold dimension.
proof_scope.310Y: Complete W1 pushforward estimate and emergence comparison under measure-preserving bi-Lipschitz conjugacy; no inference through coordinates singular at poles or centers.
proof_scope.310Z: Cites maximal-emergence local construction and derives all-parameter genericity from BT25b Proposition 1.6 and Theorem E, with exact dimension upper bound from 310X.
proof_scope.311A: States the stable-manifold theorem for every x in a compact hyperbolic set, not just periodic points. General theorem is external; the diagonal linear example is directly computed.
proof_scope.311B: Complete open-and-closed Taylor identity theorem on connected real-analytic manifolds. The hypothesis is equality on a nonempty open set, not equality outside an arbitrary open region.
proof_scope.311C: Defines Lyapunov exponents, proves norm independence, states Oseledets with both logarithmic integrability conditions, and invokes its determinant conclusion for the two-dimensional area-preserving pair. Oseledets is external. Ergodicity is sufficient, not necessary, for almost-everywhere constant exponents.
proof_scope.311D: Cites Pesin entropy formula only for a compact boundaryless C-infinity surface diffeomorphism preserving smooth area. Proves the derivative-integral limit by Oseledets and dominated convergence; does not purport to prove the entropy formula.

remaining_branches.scope: Newhouse sink creation, parablenders, polynomial renormalization, universality constructions, KAM persistence and parameter-family localizability, positive-entropy implantation, wandering Fatou components and analytic realization are not reproduced as full proofs.

Oseledets and Pesin are cited with compactness, differentiability, invertibility and measure assumptions. Original proof PDFs were not read. The local norm-invariance, two-dimensional specialization and dominated-convergence calculations are explicit.

Main Conjecture 1.8 remains conjectural in the general C-infinity setting; Problems 1.10-1.11 on positive parameter measure and larger Hausdorff dimension are not inferred from residuality. Surface global diffeomorphisms are not substituted for annulus local diffeomorphisms.

Higher-dimensional Cr, r>=2, nonconservative universality; exact symplectic near-identity renormalization; analytic surface and conservative polynomial universality remain Questions/Problems 2.11-2.14.

Analytic disk perturbations, elliptic billiards and integrable surface geodesic flows retain Problems 2.16-2.18. Question 2.19 is not resolved. No analytic or arbitrary-parameter entropy theorem is inferred from a smooth single-map perturbation.

Maximal-order all-parameter genericity is stated only in the jointly C-infinity nondegenerate elliptic symplectic setting. Main Problem 3.5 and broader nonconservative typicality remain open. Maximal oscillation examples are self-maps, not diffeomorphisms.

3113 distinguishes integral of pointwise limsup from limsup of integrals. 3114 uses the averaged convention of the primary analytic papers. No unconditional equality between the conventions is asserted.

The report's return-box/folding architecture and positive-measure Henon consequence are explained. Full combinatorial strong-regularity criteria, Cantor inclusion estimates, Lorenz computer-assisted verification and standard-map numerical claims are not expanded.

No diagram was needed for the elementary arguments and no image-only source figures are reproduced. Parent owns global deduplication, registries, normalizeFormat, build, browser and publication checks.

normalization_notes: Definition 2.1 in both the official report and arXiv:2510.12929v1 prints disjoint tower levels 0<=k<n, where n is ambient dimension although N is return time. 310D uses 0<=k<N. This is an editorial mathematical correction supported by the return-tower definition, not a claim that the preprint already corrects it. The correction is recorded only here, not in public source metadata.

Official Theorem 2.7 combines Symp_e^infinity notation with C^r prose. 310P does not infer all finite-r or analytic versions: it uses BT25b v1 Theorems C/E and Proposition 1.5 on jointly C-infinity families in the nondegenerate elliptic open set. The stronger every-parameter quantifier is attributed to that primary theorem.
Periodic counts in 310H/310I are hyperbolic fixed points of f^k; exact periods may divide k. Exact Nq period is asserted only in 310E under the N-level disjoint-return hypothesis.

The official local-order display before Definition 3.11 has |log mass|/log|log epsilon| in both HTML and PDF text. 3113 instead uses the exponential-order double-log normalization verified in Helfter and the analytic primary papers. This source-display issue is not copied into mathematical bodies.

3113 uses log(1+|log mass|) to give atoms and mass-one balls the natural zero-order value. Positive-order small-mass asymptotics agree with the usual log|log mass| formula. It explicitly separates pointwise-integrated and averaged-before-limsup conventions.
Emergence order uses log log max{e,E(epsilon)} to define order zero for bounded emergence. This normalization does not alter any positive-order conclusion.

3102 now contains only the uniform hyperbolicity definition. Basic sets/continuation are isolated in 3119, and the stable-manifold theorem for every x in a hyperbolic set is isolated in 311A. 3103/3105/310A/310G link these prerequisites.

3104 proves basin equality B=union_{n>=0} f^{-n}(union_{0<=j<q} f^j(D)), hence the whole basin is open; it reuses 0F0D Jordan decomposition and 0F01 nilpotence. Its dependency on empirical-measure page 310R does not return to sinks.
310B records finite-order Taylor, chain-rule and Leibniz estimates and links the calculus prerequisites. It makes no analyticity or all-derivative cutoff assertion.
311B uses equality on one nonempty open set. The earlier phrase 'identity outside a nonempty open region' was removed because that outside set need not contain any open subset.
3112 explicitly identifies Henon complexification as an automorphism of C^2, two complex coordinates, not of C.

311C now states: if the measure is ergodic, the exponents and multiplicities are almost everywhere constant. Ergodicity is sufficient, not necessary; an identity map with a nonergodic measure already has constant zero exponents.

311D restricts the Pesin formula to a compact boundaryless C-infinity diffeomorphism preserving smooth positive area. The derivative-integral argument is separate from the external entropy theorem. No arbitrary invariant-measure or higher-dimensional maximum-only formula is asserted.
